# Consistent AI characters across every scene of a multi-scene ad

**Actor photos and a scene script become a multi-scene 9:16 ad where faces, outfits and the location stay the same.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_bba512ea33c7.webp" alt="The same two gym actors stay consistent across vertical scenes: a big man squatting next to a pale-haired coach, then both posing in the same bright studio." width="480"></p>

Makes multi-scene ad videos on varg in which the same people, outfits and location stay consistent in every shot, built from real actor photos or generated characters: one profile card per actor, an empty location card, scene composites approved as stills first, then image-to-video with native dialogue audio, trimmed and captioned in one cloud render. Also covers frame and audio QA of the output and turning a reference video into a scene script. Use when a script names actors (A1, A2), a location (L1) and numbered scenes, when someone sends actor or model photos, or asks for a consistent character, the same person in every scene, a recurring mascot or brand character, a UGC or skit ad with two actors, or to remake a reference ad with new people. Not for one speaker on a stage (use varg-character-keynote), seated two-person podcast dialogue (use varg-podcast-video), music videos (use varg-music-video), or one-off images and clips (use varg-ai).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill varg-consistent-characters                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills varg-consistent-characters --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 78 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Makes | Captioned multi-scene 9:16 MP4 ad |
| Needs | a varg account (OAuth through the varg MCP) or `VARG_API_KEY` |
| Typical cost | ~$0.65 stills + ~$4–5 video per 5-scene, 22 s ad (estimate) |
| Uses | varg API, Nano Banana 2.1, Kling 4, Seedance 2.5, Mureka 9.5, Whisper, Bun, FFmpeg |
| Works in | Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and other Agent Skills tools |
| Agent instructions | [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md) (v1.0.0) |

## Ask your agent

- "Here are photos of two actors, ./a1.jpg and ./a2.jpg: make a 5-scene 9:16 gym ad where they look the same in every shot"
- "Remake this reference ad ./ref.mp4 with new people, keeping the same scenes and timing"
- "My script has A1, A2, location L1 and four scenes: show me the stills first, then make the video with dialogue"
